name: Reasoning about cause and effect
gist: Helping AI understand not just correlation but causation—which gene or drug actually causes a disease—through causal inference and interpretable reasoning.
explain: A person gets sick. A genome-wide scan finds a thousand genes that correlate with the disease. Which gene actually causes it? A treatment works in mice but fails in humans. Was it something unobserved that was different between the two? A study finds that people who take vitamins live longer. Is it the vitamin, or are they healthier for other reasons? These are questions about causation — what actually causes what — and they are notoriously hard to answer from data alone.

The challenge is that correlation is easy but causation is invisible. Two things can correlate because one causes the other, because the other causes the first, because both are caused by something hidden, or by pure accident. Machine learning usually finds correlations — patterns that predict one thing from another. It does not naturally distinguish between 'A causes B' and 'C causes both A and B.' In medicine and biology, this is critical: if you make a treatment based on a correlation that is actually due to confounding, it might be useless or harmful.

This cluster uses causal inference — techniques that try to untangle causation from correlation. Some use the structure of known causal relationships (a gene causes a protein, a protein causes a disease, but not the other way), then test whether that structure fits the data. Others use experimental tricks: if we can intervene on one variable (give people a medicine, edit a gene) and see what changes, that teaches us causation directly. Still others use reasoning about counterfactuals: what would happen if we changed this one thing and nothing else? Papers here combine machine learning with causal reasoning, building models that explicitly track what causes what, so they can predict the effect of an intervention, not just correlation with past data.

papers.title: An Information-Theoretical Framework For Optimizing Experimental Design To Distinguish Probabilistic Neural Codes
papers.contribution: The information gap accurately predicts decoder performance differences across diverse task settings, and maximizing it yields stimulus distributions that optimally differentiate competing probabilistic coding hypotheses.

papers.title: Bayesian Test-Time Adaptation via Dirichlet feature projection and GMM-Driven Inference for Motor Imagery EEG Decoding
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art EEG-TTA accuracy while running in real-time; significantly outperforms previous EEG-TTA methods.

papers.title: DISSOLVR: An Interpretable and Fast Framework for Aqueous and Organic Solubility Prediction
papers.contribution: Approaches aleatoric limit of experimental uncertainty achieving out-of-distribution generalization through structural invariance without requiring non-transparent architectures.

papers.title: DeepBlip: Estimating Conditional Average Treatment Effects Over Time
papers.contribution: First neural framework for SNMMs achieving state-of-the-art performance on clinical datasets with unbiased treatment effect estimates robust to nuisance model misspecification.

papers.title: EGG-SR: Embedding Symbolic Equivalence into Symbolic Regression via Equality Graph
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that EGG-SR consistently enhances symbolic regression across benchmarks, discovering more accurate expressions within the same time limit while tightening regret bounds for MCTS and reducing DRL gradient variance.

papers.title: GARLIC: Graph Attention-based Relational Learning of Multivariate Time Series in Intensive Care
papers.contribution: GARLIC achieves state-of-the-art AUROC and AUPRC on three ICU benchmarks (PhysioNet 2012/2019, MIMIC-III) while providing transparent, verifiable importance attribution through feature-removal trials.

papers.title: Quantifying Cross-Attention Interaction in Transformers for Interpreting TCR-pMHC Binding
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art interpretability performance on TCR-pMHC binding prediction while accurately estimating amino acid residue importance based on physical interaction regions.

papers.title: Si-GT: Fast Interconnect Signal Integrity Analysis for Integrated Circuit Design via Graph Transformers
papers.contribution: Outperforms GNN and transformer baselines on 200k delay and 187k glitch examples with substantially reduced computation compared to SPICE, enabling scalable IC verification.

papers.title: A Deep Learning Model of Mental Rotation Informed by Interactive VR Experiments
papers.contribution: Captures human mental rotation performance, response times, and behavior across this work and others' experiments with demonstrated component necessity.

papers.title: AutoNumerics-Zero: Automated Discovery of State-of-the-Art Mathematical Functions
papers.contribution: Evolution discovered a 10-operation program approximating exponential to 14 significant figures, exceeding previous known approximations of this size by more than 6 orders of magnitude.

papers.title: Bayesian Post Training Enhancement of Regression Models with Calibrated Rankings
papers.contribution: Shows 97.65% median improvement across 12 datasets over prior state-of-the-art with calibrated ranking.

papers.title: Breaking the Simplification Bottleneck in Amortized Neural Symbolic Regression
papers.contribution: Achieves better accuracy than amortized baselines and performs on par with state-of-the-art direct optimization while recovering more concise expressions.

papers.title: CP-Agent: Context‑Aware Multimodal Reasoning for Cellular Morphological Profiling under Chemical Perturbations
papers.contribution: Achieves F1-score of 0.896 on treatment/MoA discrimination while providing interpretable rationales to guide hypothesis refinement in drug discovery.

papers.title: CalPro: Prior-Aware Evidential Conformal Prediction with Structure-Aware Sensitivity Bounds for Protein Structures
papers.contribution: Achieves at most 5 percentage points coverage degradation across modalities, reduces calibration error by 30-50%, and improves downstream docking success from 52% to 75%.

papers.title: CodeBrain: Towards Decoupled Interpretability and Multi-Scale Architecture for EEG Foundation Model
papers.contribution: CodeBrain achieves strong generalization across 8 downstream tasks and 10 datasets under distribution shifts with improved interpretability.

papers.title: Compositional Neuro-Symbolic Concepts in Neural Activities
papers.contribution: Incorporating structure improves both decoding accuracy and generalization across brain regions.

papers.title: Controllable Molecule Generation via Sparse Representation Editing: An Interpretability-Driven Perspective
papers.contribution: Generates chemically desirable molecules under complex constraints in real-world scenarios while offering mechanistic insights for quantitative structure-property analysis.

papers.title: DecAEvolve: Decompose, Adapt, and Evolve for Effective LLM-based Scientific Equation Discovery
papers.contribution: DecAEvolve significantly improves accuracy and efficiency of equation discovery across diverse scientific benchmarks, reducing error by up to an order of magnitude.

papers.title: Decentralized Attention Fails Centralized Signals: Rethinking Transformers for Medical Time Series
papers.contribution: CoTAR achieves up to 12.13% improvement on APAVA dataset with merely 33% memory usage and 20% inference time compared to attention-based approaches.

papers.title: Discovering Ordinary Differential Equations with LLM-Based Qualitative and Quantitative Evaluation
papers.contribution: Achieved superior performance in success rates and accurately recovering correct symbolic terms of ground-truth equations.

papers.title: Extending Sequence Length is Not All You Need: Effective Integration of Multimodal Signals for Gene Expression Prediction
papers.contribution: Proper modeling of multimodal epigenomic signals achieves state-of-the-art performance using only short sequences for gene expression prediction.

papers.title: Foundation Models for Causal Inference via Prior-Data Fitted Networks
papers.contribution: CausalFM provides a general recipe for training foundation models for causal inference with competitive performance on CATE estimation across benchmarks.

papers.title: GenUnfold: Rapidly Predict Protein Mechanical Unfolding Trajectory via a Physics-Guided Diffusion Model
papers.contribution: GenUnfold reduces distributional error (FID) by 30% and 54% compared to ESM-2 and standard transformer respectively, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance on protein unfolding trajectory prediction.

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Neural Optimizer for Shape Optimization and Inversion
papers.contribution: GANO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with stable controllable deformations, demonstrating +55.9% lift-to-drag improvement for airfoils and ~7% drag reduction for vehicles.

papers.title: IGC-Net for conditional average potential outcome estimation over time
papers.contribution: First neural model for fully regression-based G-computation in time-varying setting, significant step toward personalized decision-making from EHRs.

papers.title: Influence-Guided Symbolic Regression: Scientific Discovery via LLM-Driven Equation Search with Granular Feedback
papers.contribution: Demonstrates effectiveness on diverse benchmarks including LLM-SRBench and real-world genomic data; identifies novel relationship between DNA methylation and RNA Polymerase II pausing in a high-dimensional case study.

papers.title: Interpretability Driven Evolutionary Approach for the Design of Biological Sequences
papers.contribution: 19% acceleration in design across eight continuous-property datasets while maintaining favorable Pareto tradeoff on acceleration, diversity, and novelty.

papers.title: Learning Adaptive Topology with FiLM-Guided Distillation for Tertiary Structure-Based RNA Design
papers.contribution: Extensive experiments on tertiary structure-based RNA design benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves significant improvements in both sequence recovery and structural fidelity..

papers.title: Learning Treatment Allocations with Risk Control Under Partial Identifiability
papers.contribution: Method enables provably safe treatment allocation learning despite partial identifiability of treatment risk.

papers.title: Neural–Evolutionary Symbolic Regression with Global Constraints: Constraint-Aware Decoding and Reward Shaping
papers.contribution: GCN-SR consistently improves exact recovery over strong neural and hybrid baselines on symbolic regression benchmarks under matched evaluation budgets.

papers.title: Omni-Weather: Unified Multimodal Foundation Model for Weather Generation and Understanding
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance in both weather generation and understanding, showing that generative and understanding tasks mutually enhance each other.

papers.title: PPI Candidate Ranking: Large-Scale Evaluation of a Domain Knowledge–Guided Pipeline
papers.contribution: Achieves significant improvements over state-of-the-art PPI prediction models on large-scale dataset from successive STRING releases.

papers.title: ProMiSE: Protein Multi-State Evaluation Benchmark in Biological Contexts
papers.contribution: Reveals that current models exhibit limited multi-state sampling and insensitivity to biological context, with training-data exposure shifting predictions toward dominant states.

papers.title: Robust Equation Structure learning with Adaptive Refinement
papers.contribution: Achieves lower error and higher accuracy than baselines on LLM-SRBench; recovers near-exact functional forms on out-of-distribution data.

papers.title: SR-Scientist: Scientific Equation Discovery With Agentic AI
papers.contribution: Outperforms baselines by 6-35% across four science disciplines; demonstrates robustness to noise and generalization of discovered equations.

papers.title: Scalable Bayesian Inference for Nonlinear Conservation Laws
papers.contribution: Recovers posteriors over nonparametric source fields in seconds while outperforming neural baselines on inverse problems.

papers.title: Seizure-Semiology-Suite($S^3$): A Clinically Multimodal Dataset, Benchmark, and Models for Seizure Semiology Understanding
papers.contribution: Achieves F1 score 0.96 on epileptic vs non-epileptic classification; establishes benchmark for safety-critical medical video understanding.

papers.title: Spike-based Digital Brain: a novel fundamental model for brain activity analysis
papers.contribution: Spike-DB outperforms existing methods in prediction accuracy and downstream tasks on epilepsy and Alzheimer's Disease datasets.

papers.title: Towards Interpretable Visual Decoding with Attention to Brain Representations
papers.contribution: Provides competitive visual reconstruction quality on fMRI datasets with greater transparency into how different cortical areas influence generation.

papers.title: Unleashing Scientific Reasoning for Bio-experimental Protocol Generation via Structured Component-based Reward Mechanism
papers.contribution: Thoth consistently surpasses proprietary and open-source LLMs with significant improvements in step alignment and semantic accuracy.

papers.title: Unveiling the Mechanism of Continuous Representation Full-Waveform Inversion: A Wave Based Neural Tangent Kernel Framework
papers.contribution: Proposes IG-FWI hybrid representation combining INR and multi-resolution grids achieving balanced robustness and high-frequency convergence improvements.
